system_thesis_interpretation: The proposal is a deliberately low-complexity systems assay, not an implementation of the owner's eventual free-flow thinker. Its valid unit is one paired life with exactly two acquisition policies: a permanently null-adapter HARNESS and an EXPERIENTIAL life whose only extra adaptive channel is two cumulative deterministic LoRA rebuilds from its own verified immediately improving public actions. Both retain their own bounded external memories. The final EXPERIENTIAL_OFF execution is a read-only intervention on the EXPERIENTIAL snapshot, not a third learning system. D_HE is therefore a whole-path contrast that includes policy-induced divergence in later external memory, while D_ONOFF is the cleaner final-snapshot adapter-mount diagnostic. Neither contrast from one life establishes efficacy, mechanism, transfer, semantic generalization, or functional correctness. Systems success is only an auditable, fail-closed execution of the ratified recipe; score sign cannot determine RECIPE_COMPLETE.
graph_delta_interpretation: The operative graph should be implemented as capability-separated components and append-only, hash-chained artifacts: a sealed environment-manifest source feeds a task router; authoritative environment state plus a read-only life snapshot feeds a canonical packet builder; a cold inference worker produces raw bytes; a strict parser converts those bytes to one charged requested action or canonical no-op; the environment transaction emits a complete event; the event feeds within-task history and, only for qualifying acquisition improvement, that life's bounded public memory. A separate immutable full EXPERIENTIAL acquisition ledger, not the eight-record model memory, feeds the model-free sleep selector. The writer binds producing user bytes and canonical target bytes, deterministically trains from the clean base, and atomically publishes an adapter plus receipt. At the end, sealed HARNESS and EXPERIENTIAL snapshots feed cold target forks with mount capability fixed before prompt construction; forks have write-only access to quarantine, and only a post-destruction reporter may read it. Control-plane artifacts such as condition, role, row counts, hashes, receipts, future tasks, and target classifications must never enter model packet construction. Every graph edge needs a schema, content hash, producer/consumer identity, and failure transition; stage-level visibility labels alone are not an access-control implementation.
loop_delta_interpretation: WAKE is six independent request transactions per task, not a persistent chat: reconstruct from authoritative pre-slot state, serialize exact bytes, prove context fit without truncation, make one greedy call, parse once, charge the slot, apply at most one environment action, and atomically commit a full event before the next packet. History is task-local and complete; public memory is life-local, acquisition-only, ordered by a globally defined event sequence, and capped by evicting the oldest improving record. A malformed response becomes requested pass -1 with parse_valid false; a deliberate -1 has parse_valid true; neither calls the pass service. A valid rejected pass must have an explicitly defined unchanged current state and canonical history representation. Unknown post-state or process loss terminates that cell without retry or fabricated suffix slots. SLEEP is a barrier after completed EXPERIENTIAL tasks 4 and 8: freeze the full acquisition ledger, select and deduplicate cumulative rows, destroy any prior training process, rebuild from the clean pinned base with the exact ordered sample stream, validate every update and tensor, publish by atomic promotion, and destroy all ephemeral state. Sleep 2 replaces rather than incrementally extends sleep 1. The final target barrier must identify exactly which determinism-checked sleep-2 build is authentic, seal snapshots, start every fork cold, forbid life writeback, and delay all quarantine reads until every fork has ended. Any precondition or lifecycle failure must map unambiguously to stop-the-life plus INTEGRITY_FAILURE or to a specifically permitted target-cell INDETERMINATE state.
claim_delta_interpretation: The only defensible claim is operational: the exact minimal public-experience-to-LoRA recipe either completed all required receipts and target cells under its integrity contract, was integrity-invalid, or was integrity-clean but had a required indeterminate target cell. Raw curves, parse/service validity, F, D_HE, and D_ONOFF are descriptive telemetry. D_HE cannot isolate weights because post-sleep actions can change EXPERIENTIAL's later external-memory contents; D_ONOFF isolates mounting the final adapter conditional on one frozen EXPERIENTIAL snapshot, although its within-target trajectories may diverge after the first action as intended. Syntactically distinct hashes do not establish semantic independence. Because best_count includes the reset count, the declared formula with positive d_i implies F_i is never below zero; the current sentence permitting negative F is mathematically inconsistent and must not be used to broaden interpretation. Above-one F remains possible. No score threshold, favorable direction, p-value, confidence interval, mechanism, functional-correctness statement, superiority, lifelong behavior, saturation, population inference, or paper claim follows from this life.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The matrix is a policy summary, not sufficient enforcement. Visibility must be refined per principal: packet builder, inference worker, parser, environment service, memory writer, immutable event ledger, sleep selector/trainer, mount manager, target router, quarantine writer, reporter, reviewer, and sealer. Inference workers may see only SYSTEM_TEXT plus their current canonical user packet and mounted effective weights; they may not see raw URIs, condition or target roles, future tasks, receipts, adapter names, trainer state, or other lives. The bounded memory visible in a packet is distinct from the full sealed ledger visible only to the writer. The CPU sealer may see catalog identifiers and reset/Autophase/Oz data but must have no model, adapter, acquisition-ledger, learned-action, optimized-trajectory, or quarantine read capability. Target forks receive one sealed snapshot read-only, one fixed mount, one target-local environment, and write-only quarantine access; they cannot mutate memories, adapters, manifests, splits, other forks, or later targets. The reporter's read capability activates only after a barrier proves all forks and model processes destroyed. Audit visibility occurs after execution and cannot become a backchannel. Exact snapshot hashes, mount hashes, reader/writer capability inventories, process identities, open-file/network surfaces, and teardown receipts are needed to demonstrate the policy.
acceptance_test_interpretation: V6S_T01 must use literal byte goldens for every packet/history/memory schema state, ASCII-whitespace-only response acceptance, duplicate-key and bool rejection, UTF-8 and integer bounds, valid versus malformed -1, service rejection, worsening state, observation evolution, slot charging, memory cap/eviction, no target writes, score denominators, non-clipping, and first-applicable disposition. It must also prove a finite worst-case packet; the current unbounded integer domains make that impossible. A formula property test should require F>=0 under best-so-far scoring, exposing the proposal's contrary sentence. V6S_T02 must independently fixture eligibility predicates, producing-byte binding, event sequence, earliest dedup tie-breaking, cumulative task cutoffs, row sort and 24-copy order, exact chat-template/EOR tokenization, 1,024-token abort, target-only labels, q/v-only module inventory, optimizer and clipping order, one-update-per-sample counts, finite metrics, complete tensor serialization, deterministic comparison math, and fault injection before every atomic-publish boundary. Synthetic comparison math does not substitute for the two real clean-process rebuilds required at run time. V6S_T03 must exercise the complete state machine and actor-level capability graph: null/base equivalence, tasks-1-through-4 packet/weight/output/action/environment parity, sleep barriers, restart-as-fail-closed rather than resume, stale-cache/RNG/trainer cleanup, exact snapshot byte identity for ON/OFF, fixed mounts, cold target resets, no memory writeback, write-only quarantine, reporter barrier, and injected process/storage failures. V6S_T04 must run a pinned number of cold repetitions and produce byte-identical catalog normalization, exact master-seed encoding, URI ordering, collision handling, source/bitcode hashes, fixed-shape observations, I0/IOz values, eligibility decisions and rejection transcript, 8/4 assignment, and sealed-manifest hash. Its dependency and capability audit must demonstrate absence of model, learned-action, adapter, Fable, target-trajectory, download, patch, and substitution inputs. V6S_T05 must bind a content-addressed closure of exact source, fixtures, receipts, model/tokenizer/chat template/system text, module catalog, environment/runtime libraries, hardware and deterministic flags, seed bytes, commands, expected artifact schemas, and audited capabilities. The independent reviewer must issue its own non-overridable verdict; the advocate may answer concerns but cannot convert rejection to approval. Rohin's later ratification must bind the reviewed exact closure. In addition to these pre-GPU tests, the architecture needs an explicit run-time conformance acceptance test covering actual acquisition receipts, both sleeps, two clean determinism builds, authentic/null mounts, target quarantine, disposition calculation, and fail-closed behavior; otherwise T01-T05 can all pass while the executed life violates the recipe.
assumptions: The full sealed EXPERIENTIAL acquisition event ledger is an audit and writer input distinct from, and not truncated with, the at-most-eight records exposed as model memory.

Each memory record's observation is the pre-action observation contained in the exact packet that produced the qualifying action, pre_best is best_count before that action, and improvement equals pre_best minus post_count.
A target fork maintains target-local history across its six slots but never appends to either source life's public memory or acquisition ledger.

An environment action is committed only when one service response atomically establishes acceptance, post-count, and the complete next observation; partial state is indeterminate and is never repaired.
The later run manifest may fill explicitly delegated byte-level parameters, but it may not resolve a semantic contradiction or add a retry, fallback, control, reader, writer, optimization, or claim.

Canonical null-adapter behavior means effective inference weights are exactly the pinned base behavior, including before EXPERIENTIAL's first successful sleep, even if a serialized null artifact is mounted.
No architecture interpretation, consensus, or favorable test result itself authorizes implementation or execution; the two explicit human boundaries remain controlling.

ambiguities.question: Is event_seq the zero-based sequence of every acquisition slot, every accepted action, or only improving records, and is it scoped per life?
ambiguities.impact: Memory ordering, eviction, dedup retention, receipts, and reproducibility can disagree even with identical action outcomes.

ambiguities.question: For a parse-valid pass rejected by the service, must current_count, post_count, and observation equal the pre-action state, and what exact values enter history?
ambiguities.impact: The next packet is not uniquely reconstructible, so on-policy trajectories and training eligibility can diverge.

ambiguities.question: Does a deliberate or canonical no-op reuse the authoritative pre-slot observation byte-for-byte, and must history post_count equal pre_count?
ambiguities.impact: Canonical state transition and packet goldens are underdetermined.

ambiguities.question: Does any indeterminate acquisition task, failed sleep-1 publication, zero-row sleep, or null receipt failure stop the entire life as INTEGRITY_FAILURE, and are later slots/tasks forbidden after that point?
ambiguities.impact: The protocol defines target INDETERMINATE but not a total disposition table for acquisition and sleep failures.

ambiguities.question: Do the two final clean builds include the ordinary sleep-2 publication or occur in addition to it, and which exact build/hash is mounted as the authentic final adapter?
ambiguities.impact: The target treatment is not uniquely identified, particularly when tolerance passes despite byte-different adapters.

ambiguities.question: What exact tensors, shapes, dtypes, missing/extra-name rules, NaN handling, flattening order, accumulation precision, and norm algorithm define the determinism comparison?
ambiguities.impact: Different valid implementations can return different pass/fail verdicts at the target gate.

ambiguities.question: What exact canonical schema and hash domain constitute a sealed life snapshot: memory alone or also tasks_completed, sleep_index, event counter, and other public state?
ambiguities.impact: The asserted ON/OFF same-state intervention and fork isolation cannot be byte-verified.

ambiguities.question: What canonical URI normalization, master_split_seed byte encoding, catalog duplicate policy, hash-collision policy, and eligibility rejection precedence must the sealer use?
ambiguities.impact: Independent sealers may choose different 8/4 programs from the same local catalog.

ambiguities.question: How many cold reset/Autophase/Oz repetitions must T04 perform, and must every observation and baseline be byte-identical across fresh processes?
ambiguities.impact: The expected reproducibility criterion for the environment manifest is not testable as written.

ambiguities.question: Which kernels, batching/concurrency, seed state, tie-breaking, logits dtype, decoding limits, stop/EOR handling, and output-byte extraction are pinned for greedy inference?
ambiguities.impact: Tasks 1-4 can diverge between nominally identical systems and target reruns can change without sampling.

ambiguities.question: Is every slot's observation the environment observation of the current pre-action state after all prior accepted actions, including worsening actions?
ambiguities.impact: Packet reconstruction and causal row binding are otherwise ambiguous.

ambiguities.question: What exact canonical null-adapter bytes, tensor inventory, mount procedure, hash, and effective-base equivalence check are required?
ambiguities.impact: HARNESS/EXPERIENTIAL pre-sleep parity and the ON/OFF intervention may be confounded by mount implementation.

ambiguities.question: What finite enumerated set of files, libraries, environment variables, hardware properties, services, commands, and runtime readers is meant by every undeclared or changed byte?
ambiguities.impact: The run-manifest verifier has no implementable acceptance boundary without a closed-world surface definition.

ambiguities.question: What primitive proves target results are append-only/write-only to forks and unreadable until every fork and model process is destroyed, including after a crash?
ambiguities.impact: Target information could leak between conditions or into later target decisions despite packet-level filtering.

ambiguities.question: Why does architecture ratification authorize the CPU sealer while the later run ratification also lists the unchanged CPU sealer, and which invocation and output bytes are permitted at each boundary?
ambiguities.impact: Operators could either block the manifest needed for review or rerun a sealer outside the intended authority.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The protocol cannot require a pre-call proof for the largest legal packet while declaring counts and observation entries merely finite nonnegative or integer values with no magnitude or serialized-length bounds.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Those JSON integer domains are unbounded, so no largest legal packet exists. The eight observations copied into memory amplify the problem. A runtime overflow abort does not satisfy the stated preflight proof.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Add manifest-bound integer/array and serialized-packet byte limits, define out-of-domain environment values as fail-closed indeterminate/integrity events, and make T01 prove the resulting actual maximum against both inference context and the 1,024-token writer limit.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The statement that F may be below zero contradicts the defined best-so-far score.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: best_count is the minimum including reset I0, hence best_count<=I0; eligibility requires d=I0-IOz>=1; therefore F=(I0-best_count)/d>=0. Worsening current states do not change this inequality.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Delete below-zero from the protocol and add an F>=0 property golden, or explicitly change the metric from best_count to final current_count and re-ratify that materially different scoring rule.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: Greedy decoding alone does not establish the deterministic inference needed for matched tasks 1-4 or reproducible target decisions.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Kernel nondeterminism, dtype, batching, concurrency, tie-breaking, state initialization, output limits, and response extraction can change argmax outputs without sampling. The final double-build gate covers training, not inference.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Pin the complete cold-inference stack and decoding contract, require exact tasks-1-through-4 output/action/environment parity as a run integrity invariant, add repeated cold inference canaries to the later run gate, and classify any mismatch as INTEGRITY_FAILURE.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The five listed acceptance tests are all pre-GPU gates and do not constitute an explicit acceptance test for the actual model/training/target execution.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Mocks, CPU sealing, and source review can all pass while actual update counts, tensor finiteness, teardown, mounts, quarantine, target budgets, or disposition reporting violate the recipe.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Add a separately identified, later-ratified run-time conformance test that consumes actual receipts for every acquisition slot, both sleeps, the two clean rebuilds, all twelve target cells, snapshots, mounts, teardown, quarantine, metrics, and first-applicable disposition.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: A stage-level visible/derived/hidden matrix is too coarse to establish the promised visibility and no-writeback isolation.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Within ACQUISITION_SLEEP, for example, the model, controller, ledger, selector, and trainer require different rights; marking an item visible or derived for the entire stage can license forbidden lateral reads. Similar issues exist between target router, forks, quarantine, and reporter.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Require an actor-by-artifact read/write/create/delete capability matrix and enforce it in T03 with capability-denial and open-surface receipts while retaining the proposal matrix as the higher-level summary.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: Tolerance agreement between two clean builds is insufficient unless the protocol deterministically identifies the exact authentic adapter mounted for targets and its serialization closure.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Two builds can pass 1e-6 tolerances yet have different bytes and hashes. The wording also permits interpretations with two or three sleep-2 builds, so choosing A, B, or the earlier publication can change target behavior.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Define the exact build count and role, compare exact tensor-name/shape inventories with a pinned numerical algorithm, designate one build by rule as authentic, bind its adapter and tensor-manifest hashes into the sealed target manifest, and reject every alternate mount.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: T04's deterministic split is not reproducible until URI canonicalization, seed bytes, catalog/collision handling, baseline repetition, and rejection precedence are normative.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The hash formula is deterministic only over already agreed bytes, while the current protocol delegates inputs that can vary across enumerators or processes. Pairwise hash distinctness also makes eligibility depend on deterministic prior-selection rules.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Specify those rules in ratified bytes, require two or more cold sealer executions with byte-identical complete manifests and rejection ledgers, and fail rather than tie-break or substitute on any unresolved collision or baseline drift.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The lifecycle is not fail-closed until every acquisition, sleep, publication, rebuild, snapshot, fork, quarantine, and reporter failure has a unique stop/continue and disposition rule.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The text precisely identifies target-cell INDETERMINATE but leaves acquisition indeterminacy, sleep-1 zero rows, null receipt failure, atomic storage failure, and crash timing without a total run-level mapping. Implementations could continue with incomparable lives.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Add a normative transition/disposition table and test every row with fault injection in T02/T03 and the new run-time conformance test; no failure may trigger retry, substitution, partial resume, or later target opening.

open_questions: Will Rohin ratify only after the finite packet-domain and negative-score contradictions are resolved in exact protocol bytes?
Will the final architecture require a pinned deterministic inference contract and exact tasks-1-through-4 parity, rather than treating greedy decoding as sufficient?
Which exact sleep-2 build is the authentic target adapter, and how many clean sleep-2 builds are required?
Will an actor-level capability matrix, total lifecycle failure table, and explicit actual-run conformance test be added to the acceptance gate?

Which exact URI/seed canonicalization, baseline repetition count, null-adapter definition, snapshot schema, tensor comparison algorithm, manifest closure, and quarantine barrier will be bound before implementation review?

Does the first ratification permit exactly one CPU sealer invocation to create the environment manifest for review, with any run-time re-execution remaining blocked until the later exact run-manifest ratification?

After architecture changes are adjudicated, does Rohin explicitly approve only isolated B1 implementation, synthetic/mock tests, and the unchanged-local CPU no-model sealer, while all model calls, learned actions, training, targets, GPU use, downloads, patches, substitutions, retries, and claims remain forbidden until the later bound approval?
